RepoHistory.title: RepoHistory
RepoHistory.description: A previously fetched or uploaded code repository saved for quick reloading in Code Visualizer.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who saved this repository.

description.description: Repository summary or import source description.

repoUrl.description: Source GitHub URL or upload identifier.

fileCount.description: Number of source files in the saved repository.

filesPayload.description: Serialized source files array (path and content) bounded under 900KB.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the repository was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the repository was last accessed or updated.

/repoHistory/{repoId}.description: Stores per-user fetched and uploaded repository snapshots for the History tab.
